question: Who among the following is the Indian classical dancer who masters both Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is the Indian classical dancer who masters both Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing styles.
 
• She is one of the most prominent dancers in India and has been performing for several decades.
